name: Lunelle
summary: Lunelle is distinguished by a choice of smooth imitation leather or richly textured fabric, each offering its own expression of refinement. The seat rests on brushed bronze steel legs, their warm metallic tone adding depth and quiet radiance. With graceful lines and a composed silhouette, it brings an enduring sense of elegance and presence to any interior. 60.5×60.5×76.5
